name: Shimizu Kodama
source: A young woman who does her best to avoid or shrug off contact with others. In spite of what her short stature and youthful appearance might suggest, she's a full-fledged responsible adult. When speaking to other "adults", she's incredibly cautious and comes across as a little unfriendly.
translation: A young woman who does her best to avoid or shrug off contact with others. In spite of what her short stature and youthful appearance might suggest, she's a full-fledged responsible adult. When speaking to other "adults", she's incredibly cautious and comes across as a little unfriendly.
